title: Do not fall in LOVE with a stock!
summary: Hi im 22 and in college. I spent the last five years working hard to save this money, only to lose most of it in two months. I was in denial for a long time there were many chances to cut my losses, but I kept adding to my positions. $MSTR and $BMNR kill my portfolio.I’ve learned my lesson. A lot of people took losses, and “diamond hands” didn’t work this time. Now it’s time to rebuild no crying in the casino. I still believe both $BMNR and $MSTR will rise long-term, but I’m out of funds to buy more. I’ve made peace with it and I’m accepting my losses.submitted by/u/Embarrassed-Score360[link][comments]

title: Is Saylor about to crash MSTR again or is it different this time because of Bitcoin?
summary: We’ve all seen how Michael Saylor famously crashed MicroStrategy ($MSTR) back in the dot-com era thanks to wild financial engineering and aggressive bets.With how things are being played out with $MSTR now, is it really possible for Saylor to single-handedly crash his stock once more time like the old days?submitted by/u/alkjdasoad[link][comments]
